scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nexa/domain && npm run build --workspace=@nexa/api && npm run build --workspace=@nexa/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@nexa/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexa/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexa/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:domain && npm run test --workspace=@nexa/api
scripts.audit:source: node -e "const cp = require('node:child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python scripts/audit_source.py' : 'python3 scripts/audit_source.py'; cp.execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.test:ai: node -e "const cp = require('node:child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python -m pytest -q apps/ai/tests' : 'python3 -m pytest -q apps/ai/tests'; cp.execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:domain && npm run test:bdd && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:ai
